follow-up time: 30 days after the first positive COVID-19 swab (or matched index date in the control group) until November 30, 2020
outcome: Risk of upper tract renal stone surgery
cohort: Individuals in Ontario, Canada, with a positive COVID-19 test between February 1, 2020, and May 31, 2020, matched 1:2 with individuals who had a negative COVID-19 test during the same period
finding: Following a COVID-19 infection, there was no increased risk of needing common surgical procedures; in fact, there was a reduced risk of renal stone treatment, ureteral stent placement, and cholecystectomy.
